facts.statement: Hassiacosuchus was an extinct genus of small alligatorid.
facts.quote: Hassiacosuchus is an extinct genus of small alligatorid

facts.statement: The genus was named in 1935 by K. Weitzel.
facts.quote: It was named in 1935 by K. Weitzel

facts.statement: The type species of the genus is H. haupti.
facts.quote: the type species is H. haupti

facts.statement: Fossils of Hassiacosuchus have been found in Germany from the early Eocene.
facts.quote: from the early Eocene of Germany

facts.statement: Hassiacosuchus fossils were found at the Messel pit.
A second species, H. kayi, was named in 1941 by C.C. Mook.
facts.quote: A second species, H. kayi, was named in 1941 by C.C. Mook

facts.statement: Wassersug and Hecht argued in 1967 that Hassiacosuchus is synonymous with Allognathosuchus, though phylogenetic analyses later excluded H. haupti from that genus.
facts.quote: but was reassigned to Procaimanoidea in 1967 by Wassersug and Hecht, who also argued that Hassiacosuchus is synonymous with Allognathosuchus

facts.statement: Hassiacosuchus lived between 56 and 41.03 million years ago during the Ypresian to Lutetian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Ypresian to Lutetian (56 to 41.03 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group of Hassiacosuchus is Globidonta.
Hassiacosuchus is classified in the class Reptilia.
